title: Workforce CloudEvent envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON envelope used on every NATS subject, with the platform's extension attributes.

id.description: Event id, a UUIDv7. Also the NATS Nats-Msg-Id header, so JetStream dedupes it.

type.description: Event type, equal to the NATS subject, for example run.completed.

subject.description: Id of the entity the event is about, for example the run id.

tenantid.description: Extension: tenant the event belongs to. Consumers set app.tenant_id from it.

traceparent.description: Extension: W3C trace context, so traces follow events.
